name: Offbeat
source:
In Taishō-era Japan, a world caught between tradition and modernity, you fight to become a Hashira while refusing to bow to the rules that once nearly consumed you. 

At a smoky gambling den, your path collides with Tengen Uzui, a flamboyant shinobi turned Demon Slayer trying to break free from his harsh upbringing. 

Drawn together by rivalry and fascination, you push him to rethink the world he left behind, while he pulls you into his own dazzling orbit. 

Will you invite him into your world, or keep him forever at arm’s length?

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/offbeat]Itch.io[/url]]
